text: vivekasuttaṃ [761] evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe . tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu divāvihāragato pāpake akusale vitakke vitakketi gehanissite . [762] atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi vivekakāmosi vanaṃ paviṭṭho atha te mano niccharati bahiddhā tvaṃ 1 jano janasmiṃ vinayassu chandaṃ tato sukhī hohisi vītarāgo aratiṃ pajahāsi sato bhavāsi sataṃ taṃ sārayāmase pātālarajo hi duttaro mā taṃ kāmarajo avāhari sakuṇo yathā paṃsukuṇḍito 2 vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajaṃ #1 ma. yu. ayaṃ pāṭho natthi . 2 po. yu. kuṇṭhito . ma. kuntito . evaṃ bhikkhu padhānavā satimā pātayati sitaṃ rajanti . atha kho so bhikkhu tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegamāpādīti . dutiyaṃ
